items.t: Runtime — Fixed double vertical scrollbars appearing on runtime screens when the draft-version banner was shown.
Canvas — Fixed vertical resize on the Canvas so mouse wheel scrolling now extends the resize while dragging a handle.
App Builder — Unmapped label names now auto-update to match their text content as it changes.
Radio Group — Fixed extra empty space appearing below the last option in a vertical radio group.
Checkbox — Fixed checkbox labels rendering lower than the checkbox square instead of vertically centered.
Radio Group properties panel — Fixed the Values table layout breaking in the properties panel when option text was very long.
Chart — Fixed dropdown-type columns rendering blank in a chart's drilldown grid at runtime.
App Builder — Fixed Undo/Redo so resizing, moving, or removing a component creates its own undo step instead of deleting components.
Math Action — Fixed Math Action rounding results rendering as a date/time instead of a number in some cases.
App Builder — Fixed a Text area rendering shorter at runtime than the height set in App Builder.
QBO Projects sync — Enabled backend support for the accounting sync-status widget on Customer Project records.
QBO Projects sync — Implemented bi-directional sync between Method and QuickBooks Online for Customer Projects.
Outlook Gadget sign-in — Hardened Outlook Gadget sign-in by fixing TLS validation, token signature checks, and an SSRF exposure.
User Management — Added a backend role-metadata API providing one authoritative source of role and seat permissions.
User invite — Added routing logic for a new invite experience, currently limited to internal testing accounts.
User invite — Built the dialog shell and discard-confirmation flow for a new invite experience, currently limited to internal testing.
Editable Grid — Fixed an issue where custom view filters lost their sorting, filtering, and pagination after an editable grid refreshed.
Email screening (internal tool) — Added backend storage exposing held emails as a Method object for an internal review screen.
Email screening (internal tool) — Built an internal screen for staff to review and release or block held emails.
Email screening — Activated the heuristic spam gate to automatically hold clearly malicious emails before classifier review.
ActiveCampaign sync — Fixed User Administrator status not syncing correctly to ActiveCampaign and backfilled existing contacts.
Home — Fixed an issue where Home Insight cards opened grids without their saved view and filters applied.
